title: Astrid and the Promise
author: Edmund Pemberton
blurb: Odile Crane, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
